sentences.text: Det er søndag. Sam og Anna går til kirka.
sentences.english: It is Sunday. Sam and Anna go to church.

sentences.text: Lars, Marta og Nils går også.
sentences.english: Lars, Marta and Nils go too.

sentences.text: Kirka er ikke stor. Mange folk er i kirka.
sentences.english: The church is not big. Many people are in the church.

sentences.text: Alle sier: «God morgen!»
sentences.english: Everyone says: "Good morning!"

sentences.text: Presten heter Hansen. Han er glad.
sentences.english: The pastor is called Hansen. He is happy.

sentences.text: Alle synger en sang.
sentences.english: Everyone sings a song.

sentences.text: Sam synger litt. Han liker sangen.
sentences.english: Sam sings a little. He likes the song.

sentences.text: Nils synger mye.
sentences.english: Nils sings a lot.

sentences.text: Presten ber: «Gud, du er god.»
sentences.english: The pastor prays: "God, you are good."

sentences.text: Alle ber. Jeg ber også.
sentences.english: Everyone prays. I pray too.

sentences.text: Presten leser i bibelen. Han leser om Jesus. Han leser om Gud.
sentences.english: The pastor reads in the Bible. He reads about Jesus. He reads about God.

sentences.text: Bibelen er ei bok. Gud elsker alle folk.
sentences.english: The Bible is a book. God loves all people.

sentences.text: Jesus elsker oss.
sentences.english: Jesus loves us.

sentences.text: Mange snakker om Gud i kirka.
sentences.english: Many speak about God in church.

sentences.text: Nils er trøtt i kirka. Han er ti år. Han vil ha brød.
sentences.english: Nils is tired in church. He is ten years old. He wants bread.

sentences.text: Nei, Nils. Nå er det kirke. Etter kirka spiser vi brød.
sentences.english: No, Nils. Now it is church. After church we eat bread.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Jeg er sulten!
sentences.english: I am hungry!
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Du er ofte sulten, Nils.
sentences.english: You are often hungry, Nils.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Lars er ikke trøtt. Han liker kirka. Han liker sangen også.
sentences.english: Lars is not tired. He likes the church. He likes the song too.

sentences.text: Anna er glad. Hun synger med Marta.
sentences.english: Anna is happy. She sings with Marta.

sentences.text: Etter kirka drikker folk kaffe.
sentences.english: After church people drink coffee.

sentences.text: Liker du kirka, Sam?
sentences.english: Do you like the church, Sam?
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Ja, jeg liker sangen. Jeg liker ham også.
sentences.english: Yes, I like the song. I like him too.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Alle liker deg, Sam.
sentences.english: Everyone likes you, Sam.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Jeg vil komme hver søndag.
sentences.english: I want to come every Sunday.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Sam leser i bibelen. Han sier: «Gud, du elsker meg.»
sentences.english: Sam reads in the Bible. He says: "God, you love me."

sentences.text: Han sier: «Du er i hjertet mitt.»
sentences.english: He says: "You are in my heart."

sentences.text: Bra! Jesus er i hjertet ditt.
sentences.english: Good! Jesus is in your heart.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Ja. Gud er i hjertet mitt. Jeg er glad!
sentences.english: Yes. God is in my heart. I am happy!
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Etter kirka drikker folk kaffe på kafeen. Sam er mett, men Nils vil ha ost og melk.
sentences.english: After church people drink coffee at the café. Sam is full, but Nils wants cheese and milk.

sentences.text: Marta betaler ikke mye. Eplene er billige, men fisk er dyrt. Hun har ikke mye penger.
sentences.english: Marta does not pay much. The apples are cheap, but fish is expensive. She does not have much money.

sentences.text: Anna er sykepleier. Hun hjelper pasienter, og hun liker jobben.
sentences.english: Anna is a nurse. She helps patients, and she likes the job.

sentences.text: Mora og faren til Sam bor i USA. Familien er stor, og han liker den.
sentences.english: Sam's mother and father live in the USA. The family is big, and he likes it.

sentences.text: På søndag er skolen slutt, og Nils er glad.
sentences.english: On Sunday school is over, and Nils is happy.
